latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of find-skills-haya.

- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their questions or interests in extending capabilities.
- Explains how to search for, evaluate, and install skills from the open agent skills ecosystem.
- Provides usage scenarios and tips for effective skill discovery.
- Includes best practices for recommending quality, reputable skills.
- Offers guidance on what to do when no relevant skill is found.
